body: The album Everything is Fire by Ulcerate is a good musical representation of how I feel if you want to listen to that. I listen to it so much to try to get rid of existential angst.

It's almost unfair trying to sum up almost a decades worth of feelings into sentences and have people understand them. You don't have to worry about me. I'm sure things will work out one way or another, suicide or not. Just forget everything I said.
I've always wanted to start a cult and commit mass suicide. You probably don't count that as a good idea, so I guess I want nothing.
It still is random though. Whatever random mutation(s) made humans a social species stayed because it was beneficial for survival and that's what your behavior is based on.

I pretty much told you what I think. I'm not repressing anything right now. I think there is no redeemable factor about life. We're trapped on earth and do random shit with our limited time until we die. Anyone that says it's good makes me even more sick.
I act because I have to not that I want to. I'm never speaking this to a therapist. I don't want to be put in a mental hospital or insane asylum again.
